## Appearance

Paul is a boyish child with a remarkably beautiful face featuring delicate and refined traits. He has serious, dark blue eyes and a mop of naturally chestnut-brown curls.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P27](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0027), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), +1 more_

## Personality

Paul Irving is an imaginative and fair-minded child described as both a genius and a perfect little gentleman. He possesses a sober, grave, and meditative expression, yet he is manly, maintains good cleanliness habits, and is motivated simply to make a joyful noise. Additionally, he is protective of younger students, ensuring older boys do not meddle with them while showing them games.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), +3 more_

## History

Paul Irving lost his mother three years prior to his time as a student at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. He formed a quick bond with his teacher, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), often sharing his vibrant imagination with her, including stories of his imaginary rock people and a sunset land. Over time, he spent significant moments with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visiting [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where he connected with Miss Lavendar through their shared love of dream-people. Later, after his father [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) returned and arranged to marry Miss Lavendar, Paul visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while she helped prepare for the upcoming wedding.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), +19 more_

## Quotes

> "and I came back to give them to you because I thought you were the kind of lady that would like them, and because . . ."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)

> “Yes; but if dryads are foolish they must take the consequences, just as if they were real people,” said Paul gravely. “Do you know what I think about the new moon, teacher? I think it is a little golden boat full of dreams.”
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P30](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0030)

> "I’ve eaten enough to make anyone grow. I do hope, now that I’ve begun, I’ll keep on till I’m as tall as father. He is six feet, you know, Miss Lavendar."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024)

> "you can’t think what has happened! Something so splendid. Father is here . . . just think of that! Father is here! Come right in. Father, this is my beautiful teacher. You know, father."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)

> "I think you would make a splendid mother. You have just the right look in your eyes . . . the look my little mother always had. I think it’s a pity you haven’t any boys of your own."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--paul-irving.md)

Paul is a pupil in Anne's school, and the two quickly become fast friends. He shares his imaginative thoughts with her, including memories of his mother and his life with his grandmother, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits him for tea when his grandmother is away. Their connection is built on shared imaginative worlds and mutual affection as teacher and student.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), +11 more_

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--shirley.md)

[Shirley](../character/shirley.md) is Paul's teacher, and Paul is her favorite pupil. They form a bond on her first day of school when Paul gives her flowers, and they frequently take walks together, such as visiting [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and spending time with Miss Lavendar.
